name: Taoglas Monsoon 3-in-1 GNSS, Wi-Fi & LTE Antenna
notes: Only the LTE antenna of this 3-in-1 unit is included; the Wi-Fi (2.4/5.8 GHz) and active GNSS (GPS L1/GLONASS L1) elements are excluded. The datasheet gives efficiency, average gain and peak gain for free space and on a 30x30 cm ground plane at 0.3, 1, 2 and 3 m cable lengths; values here are free space with the 3 m CFD-200 cable the product ships with. Return loss is published only as a limit (< -3 dB) for all LTE bands, and no VSWR is given. Source columns merged per bucket: low = LTE700 (698-824), GSM850 (824-894), GSM900 (880-960); mid = DCS (1710-1880), PCS (1850-1990), UMTS1 (1920-2170); high = LTE2600 (2490-2690). The datasheet also lists coverage of bands as low as 617 MHz (B71) and up to 3800 MHz (B42/B43), but gives no gain or efficiency figures for them.
